name: BoolQ: Natural Yes/No Question Answering Dataset
description: BoolQ is a reading comprehension and question answering dataset for naturally occurring yes/no questions, curated by Google Research (Clark et al., NAACL 2019). Unlike datasets prompting crowdworkers to formulate synthetic questions, BoolQ samples unprompted information-seeking queries submitted to the Google search engine, each paired with an extracted Wikipedia passage and a binary boolean label (true/false). The dataset contains 15,942 examples partitioned into 9,427 training, 3,270 development, and 3,245 test examples.
